longitudinal.requirement: Verify exact predecessor authority, inventory, original method identities and actual remote reconciliation. No stale receipt substitutes for a new tree.
Absent, malformed, unsupported-version and conflicting-profile declarations remain distinct; opt-in dispatch preserves old modes.
Model/system states, corpus stages, samples, calls and recursive transitions retain different units and identities.
Typed DAG rules, unknown ancestors, forks, merges, shared roots and general evidence-review cycles are handled correctly.
Genuine round distance, planned observations and documented unsampled gaps are preserved; no clock compression or call-count substitution.
Existing populations/coverage remain intact; D=1-SCI uses the exact same distribution; empty is not zero diversity.
Match protocol, schema, view, selection and sample budgets; expose conditioned/unmatched descriptions without false comparability.
Retained/lost/newly observed sets reconcile; empty/unknown denominators and observed recurrence are correct.
Protected-tail membership and per-class states are versioned, predeclared and not selected by favorable results.
Candidate/selection/exposure/probe accounting stays separate; no invented upstream causal mapping or generic transmission score.
Exact normalization, class IDs, n and assumptions are required for categorical scenarios; no smoothing or silent renormalization.
Exact expected diversity, omission probability, absorption and target-drift identities agree with independent enumeration.
Expected versus pathwise behavior and exact support versus thresholded/empirical support are not conflated.
Separate null SHL, integer crossing, n=1, D_0=0 and numerical-range cases; no neural sample-size substitution.
Deterministic variable-n product is correct; no average n or adaptive-schedule extrapolation.
Mixture/selection algebra checks units and zero mass; source storage is not effective exposure and selected data are not the next model.
Local decline formula, flat/growth/zero endpoints, brackets and exact time distance match the registered interpretation.
Anchored fit and residual checks are independent of desired outcomes; no automatic window optimization or changed anchor.
Missing, interrupted, non-geometric and zero-diversity trajectories retain appropriate restrictions and local alternatives.
Mean panel diversity differs from pooled-distribution diversity; common panels, root weights and valid-only conditioning are explicit.
Whole trajectory units preserve dependence; branches/repeated prompts do not become independent training replicates.
Complete indices, methods, fixed units and all replicate outcomes replay exactly; failed fits cannot be selectively removed.
Finite observed intervention union remains distinct from thresholded expressibility and latent support.
Fixed stage state, complete finite family, success event, tau and paired assay identity are required.
One preregistered position per eligible independent call; no selection-conditioned denominator, optional stopping or fabricated trials.
Uncertain outcomes remain k bounds; unperformed trials and unreadable validation cannot become negative observations.
Exact tail calculations, conservative multiplicity, inclusive/strict threshold edges and resource limits are implemented correctly.
Existential present/universal below decisions, untested interventions, partial set sizes and empty registry normalization are correct.
A known pre missing expressible set is required; pre uncertainty cannot supply a missing denominator.
Exact ERR, empty M, partial post sets and incompatible criteria retain their distinct statuses and values.
Grounding, validation, state change and non-injection evidence are scoped; mock children cannot become substantive recovery evidence.
Entry, preprocessing, selection, exposure/update and subsequent expression remain separate records; no aggregate exogamy certificate.
Original anomalies and recuts remain reviewable; taxonomy change cannot count as model recovery or automatic comparable new support.
Snapshot mutations invalidate all actually dependent curves, fits, assays, missing sets and reports; unrelated results survive.
Complete source-record-to-report fixtures and CLI pass; final metrics cannot be injected as fake input evidence.
Both formats retain all scalar states, scopes, dates, denominators, omissions and redacted audit links.
Original semantic/numeric tests and historical matrices remain; new implementation fingerprints do not rewrite old reports.
Fixtures, assumptions, record completeness and source adoption never become actual independent or deployed validation.
No input execution/network access, unbounded expansion, silent approximation, redaction bypass or destructive publication fallback.
Final local software, actual delivery, owner review and E evidence stay separate, with truthful complete execution history.

oracles.requirement: A={a,b,c}, B={a,c,d}: retained={a,c}, unobserved={b}, new={d}, retention=2/3 and loss=1/3. Include known empty and unknown A.
oracles.title: O01: Observed sets

oracles.requirement: Counts (3,1): SCI=5/8 and D=3/8. Empty accepted population: D undefined. One occupied class: D=0. Preserve both effective-count names.
oracles.title: O02: Diversity

oracles.requirement: For p=(1/2,1/2), n=2, enumerate counts with probabilities 1/4,1/2,1/4; mean child D=1/4. Separately allow realized D increase on a nonuniform parent.
oracles.title: O03: Expectation versus path

oracles.requirement: Parent zero cannot produce a positive child under the exact null. For n=4, p=1/10 gives omission 6561/10000; p=1/2 gives 1/16. Empirical observed reappearance remains legal.
oracles.title: O04: Absorption and rarity

oracles.requirement: p=(3/4,1/4), q=(1/2,1/2), n=4: L=1/8, D=3/8, expected next L=7/32. Missing or changed q is not silently replaced.
oracles.title: O05: Fidelity

oracles.requirement: SHL_0(2)=1; verify another n with independently evaluated high-precision logarithms. n=1 and D_0=0 retain separate formula/applicability states.
oracles.title: O06: Null timescale

oracles.requirement: n=(2,4) gives expected diversity multiplier 3/8; substituting average n must fail. Adaptive schedule is unsupported.
oracles.title: O07: Variable n

oracles.requirement: A new external class with positive mixture mass can be removed by zero selection weight; all weights zero makes selection undefined. Archive membership alone supplies no update effect.
oracles.title: O08: Selection

oracles.requirement: Times (0,2,4,6) and D=(1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16) give empirical/interval SHL=2 under a documented schedule. Verify via an independent log identity.
oracles.title: O09: Local/geometric SHL

oracles.requirement: Flat, increasing, zero-ended, interrupted and strongly non-geometric paths do not acquire forced positive global SHL; requested local decline intervals remain visible.
oracles.title: O10: Fit refusal

oracles.requirement: Mean of panel D values differs from D of pooled counts; fixed equal panel/root weighting is preserved with heterogeneous frequencies.
oracles.title: O11: Aggregation

oracles.requirement: Independent small-matrix and percentile checks; saved full matrices replay; wrong units, missing indices and failed fit draws cannot be silently repaired/filtered.
oracles.title: O12: Resampling

oracles.requirement: N=4, tau=1/2, delta=1/16: four successes satisfy the inclusive present threshold; zero successes reach equality on the lower tail and do **not** establish strict below-threshold status.
oracles.title: O13: Exact support boundary

oracles.requirement: N=4, tau=3/4, delta=1/16: zero possible successes gives lower tail 1/256 and below-threshold status. Unresolved trials that increase k_possible can remove that conclusion.
oracles.title: O14: Below-threshold and unknowns

oracles.requirement: One valid positive intervention suffices for present; every allowed member must resolve below to establish below. Dropping an untested member or reducing J after inspection fails.
oracles.title: O15: Finite family

oracles.requirement: Five outputs from one call cannot supply five independent assay trials; preselecting one position is permitted. Duplicate pre/post reuse cannot fabricate a new post observation.
oracles.title: O16: Trial identity

oracles.requirement: Observed union can be positive while threshold membership is unresolved. An empirical-frequency cutoff cannot substitute for tau. Tau=1 does not become established merely from all observed successes.
oracles.title: O17: Support types

oracles.requirement: Eight-class registry, six qualified pre classes, one of two missing classes recovered: ERR=1/2. No missing classes: undefined. Pre uncertainty: no exact denominator.
oracles.title: O18: ERR

oracles.requirement: Known M of size 3, one confirmed recovered, one below, one unresolved: point ERR unavailable; separate partial bounds [1/3,2/3].
oracles.title: O19: Partial post

oracles.requirement: Mock descendant, derivative source, direct pasted answer, wrong checkpoint or incompatible success event withholds the qualified recovery claim.
oracles.title: O20: Intervention

oracles.requirement: A category split applied to the same samples can change counts without creating model ability. Preserve raw anomaly and old/new evidence; no automatic ERR gain.
oracles.title: O21: Recut

oracles.requirement: Change text, candidate position, lineage edge, support threshold, pre classification or non-injection evidence while keeping display IDs; every affected dependent result rejects stale input.
oracles.title: O22: Stale context

oracles.requirement: Traversal/symlink/remote refs, malicious prose, huge exact exponents, duplicate keys, swapped replay, private identity leaks, racing output and truncated publication attempts fail safely.
oracles.title: O23: Security

oracles.requirement: Existing M-only and A/B/C fixtures retain original numeric/scientific behavior; E remains unperformed and old D duties remain outside their original profiles.
oracles.title: O24: Scope/regression

State/kind/stage, parameter/system identity and original measurement refs.
Typed lineage, chosen paths, roots, parent contributions, round distances and gaps.
Selected, classified and valid populations, budgets, coverage and conditionality.

Null assumptions, n/schedule, exact operands, expected values, optional external target and scope.
Local/fitted SHL, start/stop, D values, real time coordinates, residuals, zero/growth/gap states and crossing brackets.
Sensitivity unit/group, complete grid, indices/hash, every draw status, interval and uncertainty limitations.
Finite assay family, model state, event, trial N, k bounds, tau/alpha/J/delta, tails and coverage.
Present/below/unresolved support sets, observed union and reference-normalized support with exact denominators.
Pre missing set, confirmed recovery, unresolved post set, ERR or separate partial bounds and intervention gates.
Exogamy stage evidence, intervention/model-state change, non-injection and validation limitations.
Preserved anomalies, recut identity, correction dependencies, old/current results and no new sample claim.
Five conjunctive conditions, all ten EC disclosures, actual versus declared currentness, omitted deployment evidence.
Processing status, redaction/access limits, resource/numeric restrictions, frozen baseline and separate publication/acceptance.
